notation usage notation system

  • CURIE: gmeow:notationUsageNotationSystem
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationUsageNotationSystem
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notation
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The notation system being used. Functional per relator: one notation system per NotationSystemUsage.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NotationSystemUsage -> gmeow:NotationSystem; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:notationUsageNotationSystem from gmeow:NotationSystemUsage to gmeow:NotationSystem when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:NotationSystemUsage, gmeow:NotationSystem

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use inside a gmeow:NotationSystemUsage relator to name the single notation system being used in this scoped, standpointed binding.

Avoid when

  • Avoid asserting more than one notation system per relator (it is functional — a second notation means a second usage) and avoid using it outside a NotationSystemUsage relator.

How to use

  • Set exactly one gmeow:notationUsageNotationSystem on each usage relator, pointing at the gmeow:NotationSystem, alongside the target, role, and interval roles.

Examples

  • ex:u gmeow:notationUsageNotationSystem ex:ipa.
